passages.context: Book I, Notitia, questions 76-95, printed pp. 51-52, especially questions 87 and 91, directly inspected. Catechumenal and water-and-salt exorcisms appear within a broader examination of priestly competence.
passages.notes: Supports administrative differentiation and the collection's competence inventory, not personal major-exorcism caseload, exorcist-office duties, actual local performance, frequency, or efficacy.
